爱.meaning: to love; to be fond of; to like doing something (爱妈妈 to love one's mother; 爱吃辣 to love spicy food)

examples.english: My little sister loves eating fruit.

爱.meaning: to be prone to; to be liable to (爱生气 to get angry easily; 铁爱生锈 iron rusts easily)

examples.pinyin: tā ài shēngqì, nǐ bié shuō tā.
examples.english: He gets angry easily — don't say anything to him.

吧.meaning: sentence-final particle marking a suggestion or softened command (走吧 let's go; 坐吧 have a seat)
sentence-final particle marking an assumption seeking confirmation (你是中国人吧? you're Chinese, right?)

八.meaning: eight (八个人 eight people); in series with 十 and 百: 八十 eighty, 八百 eight hundred

爸爸.meaning: dad; father — measure word 个, but usually used without one

百.meaning: hundred — used with other numerals and measure words (一百 one hundred; 三百块 three hundred yuan); colloquially 一百 shortens to 一百/百 in fixed frames

examples.english: This book costs a hundred yuan.

白天.meaning: daytime; the day (as opposed to night) — 白天上班 to work during the day

examples.english: He works during the day and studies in the evening.

半.meaning: half — used with a measure word (半个苹果 half an apple), after a number (一个半小时 an hour and a half), and after the hour for thirty minutes past (三点半 3:30); also 'semi-, incomplete' in fixed compounds (半天 quite a while)

包子.meaning: steamed stuffed bun — measure word 个

examples.pinyin: zǎoshang wǒ mǎi le liǎng gè bāozi.
examples.english: I bought two steamed buns this morning.

杯子.meaning: cup; glass; mug — measure word 个

examples.pinyin: zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī gè bēizi.
examples.english: There's a cup on the table.

本1.meaning: measure word for books, notebooks and similar bound items (一本书 a book; 三个本子 three notebooks)

examples.pinyin: zhè shì yī běn xīn shū.

边.meaning: side; edge; rim (桌子边上 at the edge of the table; 河边 by the river)

examples.pinyin: fángzi biān shàng yǒu yī kē shù.
examples.english: There's a tree at the side of the house.

边.meaning: side — in the frame 一边…一边… doing two things at once (一边走一边说 to walk and talk at the same time); also in 方边 words: 这边/那边 this/that side

examples.hanzi: 他一边听音乐一边写作业。
examples.pinyin: tā yībiān tīng yīnyuè yībiān xiě zuòyè.
examples.english: He listens to music while doing homework.

病.meaning: illness; sickness (生病 to get sick; 他病了 he's fallen ill)

examples.pinyin: tā dé le yī zhǒng bìng.
examples.english: He's come down with an illness.

病.meaning: to be ill; to fall sick (他病了两天 he was sick for two days)

examples.hanzi: 孩子病了，妈妈带他去医院。
examples.pinyin: háizi bìng le, māma dài tā qù yīyuàn.
examples.english: The child fell ill, and mom took him to the hospital.

near_synonyms.difference: 不 negates in general — intention, habit, present state (我不喝咖啡 I don't drink coffee); 没 negates a specific past occurrence (我没喝咖啡 I didn't drink coffee)

不.meaning: not; negates verbs and adjectival predicates (不是 it's not; 不贵 not expensive); base tone bù, pronounced bú before a fourth-tone syllable (不是 bú shì, 不错 bú cuò); in yes–no questions reduplicated verb–不–verb (去不去? going or not?)

examples.english: I'm not going to school today.

不客气.meaning: you're welcome — the standard reply to 谢谢; also 不用客气

不要.meaning: don't; must not — negative imperative (不要走! don't go!; 不要说话 don't talk)
to not want; to refuse (我不要这个 I don't want this; 他不要去 he won't go / doesn't want to go)

examples.pinyin: wǒ búyào zhè ge, wǒ yào nà ge.
examples.english: I don't want this one — I want that one.

菜.meaning: dish; cooked food; cuisine (中国菜 Chinese food; 三个菜 three dishes; 点菜 to order food)

examples.pinyin: māma zuò le sān gè cài.

菜.meaning: vegetable; greens (买蔬菜/买菜 to buy vegetables)

examples.english: I'm going to the supermarket to buy vegetables.

茶.meaning: tea — measure word 杯 or 壶 (一杯茶 a cup of tea); also plain 'tea drink' (喝茶 to drink tea)

examples.english: Please have a cup of tea.

唱.meaning: to sing (唱歌 to sing a song; 唱得很好 sings well)

超市.meaning: supermarket — measure word 家 or 个; short for 超级市场

examples.english: There are a lot of people in the supermarket.

车.meaning: vehicle; car — measure word 辆 (一辆车 a car); also for machines on wheels (开车 to drive; 坐车 to take a bus/car)

吃.meaning: to eat (吃饭 to eat / have a meal); 吃得下/吃不下 can/can't manage to eat it

examples.english: What shall we eat at noon?

穿.meaning: to wear; to put on (clothing, shoes, glasses) (穿衣服 to get dressed; 穿鞋 to put on shoes)

examples.pinyin: jīntiān lěng, duō chuān yī jiàn yīfu.
examples.english: It's cold today — put on an extra layer.

near_synonyms.difference: same word, different regional names: 出租车 is the mainland term; Taiwan says 计程车

出租车.meaning: taxi — measure word 辆 (打一辆出租车 to hail a taxi); in Taiwan usually called 计程车

大.meaning: big; large; older (by generation) (大房间 a big room; 我哥比我大 my older brother is older than me; 大雨 heavy rain)

打电话.meaning: to make a phone call; to call someone (我给他打了个电话 I gave him a call) — separable: 打个电话, 打电话给他

examples.pinyin: wǒ wǎnshang gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.

大家.meaning: everyone; everybody (大家好 hello everyone; 大家都来了 everyone has come)

near_synonyms.meaning: to reach (a goal, level, or standard)
near_synonyms.difference: 到 is physical arrival or reaching a point in time (到家 get home; 到五点 by five); 达到 is abstract attainment (达到目的 achieve a goal, 达到标准 meet a standard)

到.meaning: to arrive at; to get to (我们八点到 we arrive at eight; 到家了 I'm home)

examples.english: What time does the train get to Beijing?

到.meaning: to; until — marks an endpoint of space or time, standard in the 从…到… frame (从上海到北京 from Shanghai to Beijing; 从周一到周五 from Monday to Friday)

examples.hanzi: 我从早上八点工作到下午五点。
examples.pinyin: wǒ cóng zǎoshang bā diǎn gōngzuò dào xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn.
examples.english: I work from eight in the morning to five in the afternoon.

到.meaning: resultative complement after a verb: the action met its goal or reached its target (找到 to find, 买到 to succeed in buying, 听到 to hear a sound, 想到 to think of)

examples.pinyin: wǒ zhǎodào le wǒ de shǒujī.
nǐ tīngdào nà ge shēngyīn le ma?

大学.meaning: university; college — measure word 所 (一所大学); 上大学 to go to university

examples.english: She wants to go to university.

的.meaning: attributive particle marking modification: possessive (我的书 my book) and adjective/phrase before a noun (红色的车 a red car)

examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī liàng hóngsè de chē.

的.meaning: sentence-final particle marking emphasis or certainty in 是…的 frames and affirmations (他是昨天来的 he came yesterday; 我会去的 I'll definitely go)

examples.english: It was yesterday that he came.

第.meaning: ordinal prefix before a numeral: 第 + number + measure word (第一个 the first one; 第三次 the third time)

examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó.
examples.english: This is my first time in China.

店.meaning: shop; store — mostly as the second half of compounds (书店 bookstore; 商店 shop; 饭店 restaurant/hotel); on signs also on its own (这家店 this shop)

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de dōngxi bù guì.
examples.english: Things at this shop aren't expensive.

点1.meaning: o'clock; point in time — used after a numeral for clock time (三点 3:00; 三点半 3:30)
measure word for points/goals (考了九十分,差一点 lost by one point); also point-like items (点心 dim sum/snacks)

examples.pinyin: zhè ge cài chà yī diǎn jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: This dish was just one point short of perfect.

电话.meaning: telephone; phone call — measure word 个 (一个电话); 打电话 to make a call; 接电话 to answer the phone

电脑.meaning: computer — measure word 台 (一台电脑)

examples.pinyin: wǒ gēge yǒu yī tái diànnǎo.
examples.english: My older brother has a computer.

电视.meaning: television; TV — measure word 台 (看电视 to watch TV)

电影.meaning: movie; film — measure word 部 (一部电影; 看电影 to see a movie)

电影院.meaning: cinema; movie theater — measure word 家 or 个

examples.english: The cinema is across from the school.
My younger brother is ten this year.

东西.meaning: thing; stuff — measure word 个 (买东西 to shop / buy things)

examples.english: I'm going to buy a few things.

都.meaning: all; both — after the subject, scopes over everything before it (我们都去 we're all going; 大家都很高兴 everyone is happy)
already — with 是: 都十点了 it's already ten o'clock

examples.pinyin: dōu shí'èr diǎn le, kuài shuì!
examples.english: It's already twelve — go to sleep!

读.meaning: to read; to read aloud (读书 to read/study; 读大学 to attend university)

对.meaning: correct; right (你说得对 you're right; 这个答案不对 this answer is wrong)
to; toward; for (对他说 to say to him; 对我很友好 friendly to me)

examples.english: The teacher is very good to us.

对.meaning: to face; to be facing (房子对着公园 the house faces the park)

对不起.meaning: sorry; excuse me — the standard apology; reply is 没关系 or 没事

near_synonyms.difference: same meaning, but 许多 is more written/formal and needs no 很 (许多问题 many problems); 多 is the plain word and in the predicate almost always carries 很 (问题很多 there are many problems)

多.meaning: many; much; a lot of — modifies nouns, usually with 很 in the predicate (很多人 many people; 钱很多 there's a lot of money)

examples.pinyin: jīntiān chāoshì li yǒu hěn duō rén.
examples.english: There are a lot of people in the supermarket today.

多.meaning: more; to a greater extent — before a verb or adjective it means 'more' (多说一次 say it once more; 多穿点儿 wear more); after a numeral it means 'odd, more than' (五十多 more than fifty)

examples.hanzi: 天气冷了，多穿点儿衣服。
examples.pinyin: tiānqì lěng le, duō chuān diǎnr yīfu.
examples.english: It's gotten cold — wear some more clothes.

examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū yǒu sānbǎi duō yè.
examples.english: This book has over three hundred pages.

多.meaning: how; to what degree — interrogative before an adjective asking extent (你多大? how old are you?; 多远? how far?)

examples.english: How old is your younger brother?

examples.pinyin: cóng zhèr dào nǐ jiā yǒu duō yuǎn?
examples.english: How far is it from here to your place?

多少.meaning: how much; how many — asks quantity (多少钱? how much money?; 你们班有多少人? how many people are in your class?)

examples.english: How many people are in your class?

读书.meaning: to read; to study (在图书馆读书 to study in the library)

examples.english: My older brother is studying in his room.

二.meaning: two — used in counting, numbers, and before 十/百 (二十 twenty; 二百 two hundred); for 'two of something' use 两 (两个人)

examples.hanzi: 他们的儿子在北京工作。
examples.pinyin: tāmen de érzi zài Běijīng gōngzuò.

饭.meaning: cooked rice; meal (吃饭 to eat / have a meal; 早饭 breakfast)

饭店.meaning: restaurant — measure word 家 (一家饭店)

examples.hanzi: 我们去那家饭店吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen qù nà jiā fàndiàn chī fàn ba.

饭店.meaning: hotel — large establishments (北京饭店 the Beijing Hotel)

examples.pinyin: tā zhù zài yī jiā dà fàndiàn.
examples.english: He's staying at a large hotel.

房间.meaning: room — measure word 个 or 间 (一间房 a room)

near_synonyms.difference: 很 is the everyday linker/intensifier and often carries no special emphasis (很高 tall); 非常 is stronger and slightly more formal — genuinely 'very much'

非常.meaning: very; extremely — before adjectives (非常好吃 very tasty); stronger and slightly more formal than 很

飞机.meaning: airplane — measure word 架 (一架飞机); 坐飞机 to take a plane

examples.pinyin: wǒ míngtiān zuò fēijī qù Shànghǎi.

分.meaning: minute (of time) — after a numeral (三点十分 ten past three)
measure word for fractions and for points/scores (三分之一的收入 one third of the income; 得了十分 got ten points)

examples.pinyin: tā kǎoshì dé le yībǎi fēn.
examples.english: He got a hundred points on the exam.

分.meaning: to divide; to separate (把苹果分成两份 divide the apple into two portions; 分开 to separate)

examples.pinyin: wǒmen bǎ píngguǒ fēn chéng liǎng fèn.
examples.english: We divided the apple into two portions.

分钟.meaning: minute — measure word usage: number + 分钟 directly (十分钟 ten minutes)

examples.pinyin: hái yǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: We'll be there in ten minutes.

高兴.meaning: happy; glad (我很高兴 I'm happy; 高兴见到你 glad to meet you)

examples.english: Nice to meet you — I'm glad to see you.

个.meaning: general-purpose measure word for people and things (一个人 a person; 三个苹果 three apples) — the default when no more specific classifier applies

examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī gè miànbāo.
examples.english: I bought a loaf of bread.

歌.meaning: song — measure word 首 or 支 (一首歌 a song); 唱歌 to sing

examples.english: This song is really nice to listen to.

给.meaning: to; for — marks the recipient or beneficiary before a verb (给他打电话 to call him; 给我买了一本书 bought me a book)

examples.pinyin: qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈给我买了一件衣服。
examples.pinyin: māma gěi wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn yīfu.
examples.english: Mom bought me a piece of clothing.

给.meaning: to give (我给他一本书 I gave him a book); also passive marker 被-like (给打破了 got broken) mainly in speech

examples.pinyin: wǒ gěi le tā yī běn shū.

公司.meaning: company; firm — measure word 家 (一家公司)

examples.hanzi: 爸爸在一家大公司工作。
examples.pinyin: bàba zài yī jiā dà gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: Dad works at a big company.

工作.meaning: to work (她在银行工作 she works at a bank)
job; work — measure word 份 (一份工作 a job; 找工作 to look for a job)

examples.pinyin: wǒ zhǎo le yī fèn xīn gōngzuò.

狗.meaning: dog — measure word 只 (一只狗)

examples.pinyin: tā jiā yǒu yī zhī xiǎo gǒu.
examples.english: His family has a little dog.

贵.meaning: expensive; costly (这个太贵了 this is too expensive; 反义词: 便宜 cheap)

examples.pinyin: zhè ge shǒujī tài guì le.

国.meaning: country; state (中国 China; 外国 a foreign country) — mostly in compounds

examples.pinyin: tā shì yī gè wàiguó rén.

还.meaning: still; yet (他还没来 he still hasn't come; 还是在这儿 still here); also 'in addition, even more' (还要一杯 one more cup)
to return; to give back (还书 to return a book; 还钱 to pay back money)

examples.english: I'll return your book next week.

孩子.meaning: child; children — measure word 个 (两个孩子 two children)

汉语.meaning: the Chinese language (学汉语 to study Chinese) — slightly more formal than 中文

汉字.meaning: Chinese character — measure word 个 (写汉字 to write characters)

examples.pinyin: tā huì xiě hěn duō Hànzì.
examples.english: He can write a lot of Chinese characters.

号.meaning: date of the month — after a numeral (十月五号 October 5th)
number — in addresses, room numbers, sizes (三号 size three; 105号房间 room 105)

examples.pinyin: wǒ chuān sānshíqī hào de xié.

好.meaning: good; fine; okay (这本书很好 this book is good; 好主意 good idea)
so; very — intensifier before adjectives (好冷啊 it's so cold; 好多人 so many people)
well; properly — complements a verb, 'easy to' or 'done well' (好好学习 study hard; 好做 easy to do)

好吃.meaning: tasty; delicious (这个菜很好吃 this dish is delicious)

examples.pinyin: māma zuò de cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: The food mom makes is delicious.

好看.meaning: good-looking; attractive (for people and things) (她很好看 she's pretty; 这件衣服真好看 this outfit looks great)

好听.meaning: pleasant to hear (of music, voices, names) (这首歌真好听 this song is really lovely)

好玩儿.meaning: fun; amusing; enjoyable (这个地方很好玩 this place is fun)

examples.english: This place is a lot of fun.

和1.meaning: and — joins nouns and noun phrases (老师和同学 teachers and students); base tone hé, pronounced huò when listing alternatives in questions

examples.pinyin: lǎoshī hé tóngxué dōu lái le.
examples.english: The teachers and the students have all come.

喝.meaning: to drink (喝水 to drink water; 喝茶 to drink tea)

examples.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng hē chá háishì kāfēi?
examples.english: Would you like tea or coffee?

很.meaning: very — general intensifier before adjectives; with a plain adjective in the predicate it often just links subject and predicate without emphasis (很高 tall; 很好 very good)

examples.pinyin: tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.

后.meaning: back; behind; rear — locational (房子后面 behind the house)

examples.pinyin: fángzi hòumiàn yǒu yī gè huāyuán.
examples.english: There's a garden behind the house.

后.meaning: after; later — temporal (下课后 after class; 三天后 three days later)

examples.hanzi: 下课以后我们去看电影。
examples.pinyin: xiàkè yǐhòu wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: After class we'll go see a movie.

回.meaning: to return; to go back (回家 to go home; 回国 to return to one's country)
measure word for occurrences of an action: times (去过三回 have been three times; 这件事说了两回 mentioned it twice) — interchangeable with 次, less formal

examples.english: I've been to Beijing three times.

会1.meaning: can; to know how to (a learned ability) (我会说汉语 I can speak Chinese; 他会开车 he can drive)
to be likely to; will (a prediction or inference) (明天会下雨 it will rain tomorrow; 他会来的 he'll come)

火车.meaning: train — measure word 列 or 趟; 坐火车 to take a train

几.meaning: how many — asks a small number (几点了? what time is it?; 你有几个孩子? how many children do you have?); also 'a few, several' in statements (几天 a few days)

examples.english: How many children do you have?

家.meaning: home; family; household (回家 to go home; 我家 my home; 一家人 the whole family)
measure word for families, businesses, schools, restaurants (一家饭店 a restaurant; 三家公司 three companies)

见.meaning: to see; to meet (看见 to see; 见面 to meet — 见面 is separable: 见过一次面)

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiàn nǐ yī miàn.

件.meaning: measure word for clothing items, matters, and gifts (一件衣服 a piece of clothing; 一件事 a matter/thing)

examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn xīn yīfu.
examples.english: I bought a new piece of clothing.

叫.meaning: to be called; to be named (他叫小明 he's called Xiaoming; 你叫什么名字? what's your name?)
to call; to summon (叫医生来 call a doctor; 妈妈叫我回家 mom is calling me home)

examples.pinyin: māma jiào wǒ huí jiā chī fàn.
examples.english: Mom is calling me home to eat.

饺子.meaning: dumpling (steamed or boiled) — measure word 个

examples.hanzi: 过年的时候我们吃饺子。
examples.pinyin: guònián de shíhou wǒmen chī jiǎozi.
examples.english: We eat dumplings at New Year.

家人.meaning: family members (带家人来 bring your family)

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng dài jiārén lái Zhōngguó.
examples.english: I'd like to bring my family to China.

鸡蛋.meaning: (chicken) egg — measure word 个 (一个鸡蛋)

examples.pinyin: zǎoshang wǒ chī le yī gè jīdàn.
examples.english: I ate an egg this morning.
My older sister is a doctor.

今年.meaning: this year (今年夏天 this summer)

examples.english: This summer has been very hot.

今天.meaning: today (今天几号? what's the date today?)

九.meaning: nine (九点 nine o'clock; 九十九 ninety-nine)

examples.english: I go to bed at nine.

觉得.meaning: to think; to feel; to be of the opinion (我觉得很好 I think it's good; 你觉得怎么样? what do you think?)

examples.hanzi: 我觉得这本书很有意思。
examples.pinyin: wǒ juéde zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: I think this book is really interesting.

开.meaning: to open (开门 to open the door); opposite 关 (关门 to close the door)
to drive; to operate (a vehicle) (开车 to drive; 他会开车 he can drive)
to start; to run (of machines/meetings) (电视开着 the TV is on; 会议开始开会 the meeting begins)

开车.meaning: to drive a car (他每天开车上班 he drives to work every day)

examples.english: He drives to work every day.

看.meaning: to look at; to watch; to read (看书 to read a book; 看电视 to watch TV; 看电影 to see a movie)

examples.english: In the evening we watch TV.

看.meaning: to see and visit (看朋友 to visit friends; 去看医生 to go see a doctor)

examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ yào qù kàn péngyou.
examples.english: This weekend I'm going to visit friends.

看.meaning: to think; to consider (我看可以 I think it's okay; 你怎么看? what do you think?)

examples.pinyin: nǐ zěnme kàn zhè ge wèntí?
examples.english: What's your take on this issue?

看病.meaning: to see a doctor (下午要去看病 I have to see a doctor this afternoon)

examples.hanzi: 他不舒服，下午要去看病。
examples.pinyin: tā bù shūfu, xiàwǔ yào qù kànbìng.
examples.english: He's not feeling well and is going to see a doctor this afternoon.

看见.meaning: to see; to catch sight of (我看见他了 I saw him)

课.meaning: class; lesson; course — measure word 门 or 节 (一节课 a class period; 上课 to attend class)

examples.english: There are two class periods in the morning.

可以.meaning: can; may — permission or possibility (我可以进来吗? may I come in?; 这里可以抽烟吗? is smoking allowed here?)
okay; acceptable; not bad (这样可以吗? is this okay?; 他的汉语还可以 his Chinese is passable)

口.meaning: mouth (张口 to open one's mouth) — mostly in compounds and set phrases

examples.english: He opened his mouth and spoke.

口.meaning: measure word for family members, people in a household (三口人 a family of three), and for mouthfuls (一口水 a mouthful of water)

examples.pinyin: wǒmen jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.
examples.english: There are three people in our family.

块.meaning: measure word for money: yuan; kuai — the colloquial unit of currency (十块钱 ten yuan); the formal unit is 元

examples.pinyin: zhè ge miànbāo wǔ kuài qián.

来.meaning: to come (来我家 come to my house; 他来了 he's come)

examples.english: Come to my place and hang out.

来.meaning: directional complement after a verb: motion toward the speaker (拿过来 bring it here; 一辆车开过来了 a car came driving over)

老师.meaning: teacher — measure word 位 (polite) or 个 (一位老师)

near_synonyms.difference: 了 marks one completed action; 过 marks past experience — 我买了 (I bought it) vs 我买过 (I've bought it before)

了.meaning: aspect particle after a verb marking that the action is completed or finished (我买了 I bought it; 吃了饭再走 eat first, then go)

examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī gè miànbāo.
examples.english: I bought a loaf of bread.

examples.pinyin: tā zuótiān kàn le yī bù diànyǐng.

了.meaning: sentence-final particle marking a new situation or change of state — something has become the case (我三十岁了 I'm thirty now; 天晴了 the sky has cleared)
to finish; to be done with — in modern usage almost entirely confined to potential complements (verb + 得/不 + 了): 吃得了 can eat it, 忘不了 can't forget

examples.pinyin: zhèr tài chǎo le, wǒ shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: It's too noisy here — I can't stand it.

冷.meaning: cold (of weather, water, rooms) (今天很冷 it's cold today; 冷水 cold water); opposite 热

里.meaning: inside; in — locational, follows the noun it scopes over (房间里 in the room; 包里 in the bag); antonym 外/外边

examples.pinyin: wǒ de shū zài fángjiān li.
examples.english: My book is in the room.

两1.meaning: two — the form used before measure words for quantity (两个人 two people; 两天 two days); in counting and in 十/百 compounds use 二 (十二 twelve)

examples.pinyin: wǒ zài Zhōngguó zhù le liǎng nián.
examples.english: I lived in China for two years.

零.meaning: zero (房间号是三零五 the room number is 305; 零下五度 five below zero); also 'point zero' between digits in numbers and phone numbers

examples.pinyin: tā de fángjiān hào shì sān líng wǔ.

六.meaning: six (六个人 six people; 六十 sixty)

吗.meaning: question particle — turns a statement into a yes–no question (你是学生吗? are you a student?; 他走了吗? has he left?)

卖.meaning: to sell (这个商店卖书 this shop sells books); opposite 买

买.meaning: to buy (买东西 to shop; 我买了一个面包 I bought a loaf of bread)

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn shū.
examples.english: I'd like to buy a book.

examples.pinyin: wǒ māma zuò de fàn zuì hǎochī.
examples.english: My mom's cooking is the best.

忙.meaning: busy (最近很忙 very busy lately; 你忙吗? are you busy?)

猫.meaning: cat — measure word 只 (一只猫)

examples.pinyin: nà zhī māo zài yǐzi shàng.
examples.english: That cat is on the chair.

没关系.meaning: it doesn't matter; that's okay — the standard reply to an apology or thanks

examples.english: My younger sister is eight now.

没事.meaning: it's nothing; no problem — a casual reply to thanks or apology
to have nothing to do; to be free (今晚没事 are you free tonight?)

examples.pinyin: nǐ jīnwǎn yǒu shì ma? —— méishì.

near_synonyms.difference: 不 negates intention, habit, present state (我不喝咖啡 I don't drink coffee); 没 negates a specific past occurrence (我没喝咖啡 I didn't drink coffee)

没（有）.meaning: not; negative for completed actions and experience — 没(有)去 didn't go; 没有 is used for existence 'there isn't' (没有时间 there's no time). Unlike 不, 没 negates a specific past occurrence (我没喝咖啡 I didn't drink coffee vs 我不喝咖啡 I don't drink coffee)

examples.pinyin: wǒ méi kàn nà bù diànyǐng.

们.meaning: plural suffix for human pronouns and nouns (我们 we; 他们 they; 孩子们 the children) — never used with numbers (三个学生, not 三个学生们)

面包.meaning: bread — measure word 个 or 条 (一个面包 a loaf of bread)

examples.english: I eat bread in the mornings.

面条儿.meaning: noodles — measure word 碗 or 份 (一碗面条 a bowl of noodles)

examples.pinyin: tā chī le yī wǎn miàntiáor.
examples.english: He ate a bowl of noodles.

米饭.meaning: cooked (white) rice — measure word 碗 (一碗米饭 a bowl of rice)

examples.english: I'd like a bowl of rice.
Next year I want to go to China.

名字.meaning: name (你叫什么名字? what's your name?; 我的名字是… my name is…)

那.meaning: that — before a measure word or noun (那个人 that person; 那本书 that book)

examples.pinyin: nà běn shū shì wǒ de.

那.meaning: then; in that case (那我们走吧 then let's go)

哪.meaning: which; what — question word before a measure word or noun (哪个人? which person?; 你是哪个学校的? which school are you from?)

examples.pinyin: nǐ shì nǎ ge xuéxiào de?

那边.meaning: over there; that side (在那边 over there; 银行在哪边? which way is the bank?)

那个.meaning: that; that one (那个很好吃 that one is tasty; 你喜欢那个吗? do you like that one?)

哪个.meaning: which; which one (你想去哪个? which one do you want to go to?; 哪个国家? which country?)

examples.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ ge gōngyuán?
examples.english: Which park do you want to go to?

那里.meaning: there; that place (住在那里 live there) — slightly more formal than 那儿

哪里.meaning: where; what place (你在哪里工作? where do you work?)
not at all — polite deflection of a compliment (——你汉语说得真好！——哪里哪里 your Chinese is great — oh, not at all)

examples.pinyin: —— nǐ de Hànyǔ zhēn hǎo! —— nǎlǐ nǎlǐ.
examples.english: "Your Chinese is so good!" "Oh, not at all."

男.meaning: male; masculine (男人 a man; 男厕所 the men's room) — mostly attributive

examples.pinyin: nàbiān yǒu ge nánrén zài děng nǐ.
examples.english: There's a man over there waiting for you.

那儿.meaning: over there; that place — the northern/mainland colloquial form; 那里 is the same meaning in more careful speech

哪儿.meaning: where (你去哪儿? where are you going?) — the colloquial form of 哪里

那些.meaning: those (那些书 those books; 那些人 those people)

examples.pinyin: nàxiē shū dōu shì tā de.

哪些.meaning: which ones; which (of a known set) (哪些人可以去? which people can go?)

呢.meaning: question particle in follow-up and alternative questions (我去上海，你呢? I'm going to Shanghai — you?; 你怎么不说话呢? why aren't you talking?)

examples.english: I'm going to Shanghai — how about you?

呢.meaning: sentence-final particle marking an ongoing state or mild emphasis (他在看书呢 he's reading, you know)

near_synonyms.difference: 会 is for skills acquired through learning (会说汉语 can speak Chinese); 能 is ability or permission from circumstances (能帮你 can help you; 不能停车 can't park)

能.meaning: can; to be able to — ability or possibility from circumstances (我能帮你 I can help you; 这里不能停车 you can't park here); for learned skills use 会

你好.meaning: hello — the standard greeting; base tones nǐ hǎo (surface sandhi ní hǎo)

年.meaning: year; measure word for years — number + 年 directly with no measure word (三年 three years; 今年 this year; 明年 next year)

examples.pinyin: yī nián yǒu shí'èr ge yuè.

你们.meaning: you (plural) (你们好 hello everyone [addressing several people])

您.meaning: you (polite) — to elders, teachers, customers (您叫什么? your name, sir/ma'am?)

examples.english: What would you like to drink?

牛奶.meaning: milk — measure word 杯 or 盒 (一杯牛奶 a glass of milk)

examples.english: The child drinks milk every day.

女.meaning: female; feminine (女人 a woman; 女老师 a female teacher) — mostly attributive

examples.pinyin: tā shì yī wèi nǚ lǎoshī.
tāmen de nǚ'ér huì shuō Fǎyǔ.

女士.meaning: Ms.; madam — polite title for an adult woman (王女士 Ms. Wang)

examples.english: Ms. Wang, please sit over here.

朋友.meaning: friend — measure word 个 (一个朋友; 好朋友 good friend)

examples.pinyin: tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou.

便宜.meaning: cheap; inexpensive (这个东西很便宜 this is very cheap); opposite 贵

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de dōngxi hěn piányi.
examples.english: Things at this shop are very cheap.

漂亮.meaning: pretty; beautiful (她很漂亮 she's pretty; 这个房间真漂亮 this room is really lovely)

苹果.meaning: apple — measure word 个 (一个苹果 an apple)

examples.pinyin: wǒ měitiān chī yī gè píngguǒ.
examples.english: I eat an apple every day.

七.meaning: seven (七点 seven o'clock; 七十 seventy)

examples.pinyin: xiànzài shì qī diǎn yī kè.

前.meaning: front; before — locational (门前 in front of the door) and temporal (饭前 before a meal; 三天前 three days ago); opposite 后

examples.pinyin: fángzi qiánmiàn yǒu yī liàng chē.
examples.english: There's a car in front of the house.

examples.pinyin: sān tiān qián tā hái zài Běijīng.
examples.english: Three days ago he was still in Beijing.

钱.meaning: money (有钱 to have money; 没有钱 to have no money); 一块钱 one yuan

千.meaning: thousand (一千 one thousand; 三千字 three thousand characters)

examples.english: This phone costs a thousand yuan.

起床.meaning: to get up (from bed) (每天七点起床 to get up at seven every day)

examples.english: He gets up at six every day.

请.meaning: to invite; to treat someone (请朋友吃饭 to invite friends to a meal; 我请客 it's my treat)

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐmen chī fàn.
examples.english: I'd like to invite you all to a meal.

请.meaning: please — polite marker before a verb (请坐 please sit down; 请说 please speak)

examples.english: Please speak a little more slowly.

请问.meaning: may I ask — polite opener before a question (请问，车站怎么走? excuse me, how do I get to the station?)

examples.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

去.meaning: to go (去学校 to go to school; 我去过北京 I've been to Beijing)

去年.meaning: last year (去年的冬天 last winter)

examples.hanzi: 去年夏天我们去了海边。
examples.pinyin: qùnián xiàtiān wǒmen qù le hǎibiān.
examples.english: Last summer we went to the seaside.

热.meaning: hot (of weather, water, food) (今天很热 it's hot today; 热水 hot water); opposite 冷

人.meaning: person; people — measure word 个 or polite 位 (一个人 a person; 很多人 many people)

examples.pinyin: wū li yǒu hěn duō de rén.
examples.english: There are many people in the room.

near_synonyms.difference: 知道 covers facts and information (我知道他的名字 I know his name); 认识 is direct acquaintance with people and places, and also 'to recognize'

认识.meaning: to know (a person or place); to recognize (我认识他 I know him; 你认识这个字吗? do you recognize this character?)

examples.hanzi: 我认识他，但是不知道他姓什么。
examples.pinyin: wǒ rènshi tā, dànshì bù zhīdào tā xìng shénme.
examples.english: I know him, but I don't know his surname.

日.meaning: day; date — in dates and formal compounds (十月一日 October 1; 生日 birthday; 星期日 Sunday)

examples.pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔyuè shí rì.

三.meaning: three (三个孩子 three children; 三十 thirty)

examples.pinyin: zhuōzi shàng yǒu sān gè bēizi.
examples.english: There are three cups on the table.

上.meaning: top; above; on — locational (桌子上 on the table); opposite 下

examples.english: The book is on the table.

上.meaning: to go to; to attend (上班 to go to work; 上学 to go to school; 上课 to attend class)

examples.english: He goes to work at eight in the morning.

上.meaning: previous; last ( temporal) (上周 last week; 上个月 last month)

examples.pinyin: shàng zhōu wǒ qù kàn le yīshēng.
examples.english: Last week I went to see a doctor.

上班.meaning: to go to work (他每天八点上班 he goes to work at eight every day)

examples.english: Dad drives to work every day.

商店.meaning: shop; store — measure word 家 (一家商店)

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā shāngdiàn jiǔ diǎn kāi mén.

上课.meaning: to attend class; to go to class (学生们在上课 the students are in class)

examples.english: The students are in class right now.

上午.meaning: morning (roughly 8 a.m. to noon) (今天上午 this morning)

examples.english: I study at home in the mornings.

上学.meaning: to go to school (孩子七岁上学 children start school at seven)

examples.english: The children go to school at seven.

少.meaning: few; little; not enough (这里人很少 there are few people here; 水太少了 there's too little water); opposite 多

examples.pinyin: jīntiān lái de rén hěn shǎo.

谁.meaning: who; whom (谁来了? who came?; 你给谁打电话? who are you calling?) — also shuí, a more formal reading of the same word

生病.meaning: to get sick; to fall ill (他生病了 he's fallen ill)

examples.pinyin: tā shēngbìng le, jīntiān méi lái.
examples.english: He's sick and didn't come today.

什么.meaning: what (你叫什么? what's your name?; 这是什么? what is this?)

examples.english: What would you like to drink?

十.meaning: ten (十个人 ten people; 十二 twelve)

事.meaning: matter; affair; thing; business (一件事 a matter; 有事 have something to do; 没事 nothing wrong / it's okay)

examples.pinyin: wǒ yǒu shì, jīntiān bù néng qù.
examples.english: I have something to do — I can't go today.

是.meaning: to be — identity and classification (我是学生 I'm a student; 这是什么? what is this?); in the frame 是…的 to mark emphasis (他是昨天来的 he came yesterday)

examples.pinyin: zhè shì nǐ de shū ma?

时候.meaning: time; moment; occasion (的时候 while/when: 吃饭的时候 while eating; 小时候 when I was little)

examples.pinyin: xiǎo shíhou wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.
examples.english: When I was little I lived in Beijing.

examples.pinyin: chī fàn de shíhou bú yào shuōhuà.

时间.meaning: time (in general); free time (没有时间 to have no time; 时间过得很快 time flies)

examples.english: I don't have time to watch TV.

手机.meaning: mobile phone; cell phone — measure word 个 or 部 (我的手机没电了 my phone is dead)

examples.pinyin: wǒ de shǒujī méi diàn le.

书.meaning: book — measure word 本 or 本子 for notebooks (一本书 a book; 读书 to study)

examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi.

书店.meaning: bookstore — measure word 家 (一家书店)

examples.pinyin: shūdiàn li yǒu hěn duō xuésheng.
examples.english: There are many students in the bookstore.

睡.meaning: to sleep (睡得很香 to sleep soundly); 睡觉 to go to sleep

水.meaning: water — measure word 杯 or 瓶 (一杯水 a glass of water; 喝水 to drink water)

examples.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: Please give me a glass of water.

水果.meaning: fruit — measure word 个 or 些 (买水果 to buy fruit)

examples.english: I like eating fruit best of all.

睡觉.meaning: to go to sleep; to go to bed (早点儿睡觉 go to bed early)

说.meaning: to speak; to say (说汉语 to speak Chinese; 他说他来 he said he'd come); 说话 to talk

说话.meaning: to speak; to talk (小声说话 to talk quietly; 他会说话了 he can talk now)

四.meaning: four (四个苹果 four apples; 四十 forty)

examples.pinyin: wǒmen jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén.
examples.english: There are four people in our family.

岁.meaning: measure word for years of age (我二十岁 I'm twenty; 你多大了? / 你几岁? how old are you?)

它.meaning: it — for animals and things (它是我的 it's mine)

examples.hanzi: 这只猫很可爱，它是我的。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhī māo hěn kě'ài, tā shì wǒ de.
examples.english: This cat is adorable — it's mine.

她.meaning: she; her (她的妈妈 her mother)

太.meaning: too; excessively (太贵了 too expensive); also 'very' in praise with 了 (太好了! great!)

它们.meaning: they; them — for animals and things

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢这些猫，它们很可爱。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zhèxiē māo, tāmen hěn kě'ài.
examples.english: I like these cats — they're adorable.

她们.meaning: they; them — a group of women only

examples.english: They (the girls) are all university students.

天.meaning: day; sky (今天 today; 明天 tomorrow; 蓝天 blue sky); measure word for days — number + 天 directly (三天 three days)

examples.pinyin: wǒ zài Běijīng zhù le sān tiān.
examples.english: I stayed in Beijing for three days.

天气.meaning: weather (今天天气很好 the weather is nice today)

听.meaning: to listen to; to hear (听音乐 to listen to music; 我听不懂 I don't understand what I hear)

听见.meaning: to hear; to catch a sound (我听见有人在唱歌 I heard someone singing)

examples.pinyin: nǐ tīngjiàn le ma? yǒu rén qiāo mén.
examples.english: Did you hear that? Someone's knocking on the door.

examples.pinyin: tā shì wǒ de tóngbān tóngxué.

外.meaning: outside; external — locational (公园外 outside the park), mostly in compounds (外国人 foreigner)

examples.pinyin: gōngyuán wài yǒu hěn duō chē.
examples.english: There are many cars outside the park.

外边.meaning: outside; out there (外边很冷 it's cold outside); opposite 里边

examples.english: It's cold outside — come in quickly.

玩.meaning: to play; to have fun (孩子们在玩 the children are playing; 去公园玩 go have fun in the park)

晚.meaning: late; (of time) past the usual point (时间不晚了 it's not early anymore; 来晚了 arrived late)

晚饭.meaning: dinner; evening meal (吃晚饭 to have dinner)

晚上.meaning: evening; night (今天晚上 this evening; 晚上好 good evening)

喂1.meaning: hello — answering the phone (喂，你好 hello? [on the phone]); also to call attention (喂，看着我 hey, look at me)

examples.hanzi: 喂，你好，请问是王先生吗？
examples.pinyin: wèi, nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn shì Wáng xiānsheng ma?

问.meaning: to ask; to ask about (问他一个问题 to ask him a question); opposite 答 (to answer)

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng wèn yī ge wèntí.
examples.english: I'd like to ask a question.

问题.meaning: question; problem; issue (问老师一个问题 to ask the teacher a question; 没问题 no problem)

我.meaning: I; me (我是中国人 I'm Chinese)

我们.meaning: we; us (我们的老师 our teacher)

五.meaning: five (五个人 five people; 五十 fifty)

午饭.meaning: lunch; midday meal (吃午饭 to have lunch)

examples.english: What are you having for lunch?

下.meaning: to descend; to go down (下楼 to go downstairs); opposite 上

examples.english: Please come downstairs for a moment.

下.meaning: below; under; next (桌子下面 under the table; 下周 next week)

examples.english: The cat is under the table.

下.meaning: the fall of precipitation — the weather-verb frame 下雨 it rains, 下雪 it snows

下雨.meaning: to rain (今天下雨了 it rained today)

examples.pinyin: jīntiān xià yǔ le, bié wàng dài sǎn.
examples.english: It's raining today — don't forget your umbrella.

下班.meaning: to get off work (六点下班 to get off work at six)

examples.pinyin: tā liù diǎn xiàbān huí jiā.
examples.english: He gets off work at six and goes home.

下课.meaning: to finish class; class is dismissed (下课了 class is over)

examples.english: Class is over — let's take a break.

想.meaning: to want to; would like to (我想去 I want to go; 你想吃什么? what would you like to eat?)

examples.english: I want to go to China.
What would you like to eat?

想.meaning: to think; to suppose (我想他是对的 I think he's right)

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng tā míngtiān huì lái.

想.meaning: to miss (a person or place) (想家人 to miss one's family)

examples.english: I miss my family a lot.

先生.meaning: Mr.; sir — title after a surname (王先生 Mr. Wang)

现在.meaning: now; at present (现在几点? what time is it now?)

小.meaning: small; little; young (小房间 a small room; 我小时候 when I was little); opposite 大

小朋友.meaning: child; kid — friendly term of address for children (小朋友们好 hello, children)

小时.meaning: hour — number + 小时 directly (两个小时 two hours); 一个半小时 an hour and a half

小学.meaning: primary/elementary school (上小学 to attend primary school)

I don't have class in the afternoon.

写.meaning: to write (写汉字 to write characters; 写名字 to write one's name)

examples.pinyin: qǐng xiě xià nǐ de míngzi.

些.meaning: measure word for indefinite small quantities — used after 这/那/哪 or a number (这些书 these books; 买一些苹果 to buy some apples)

谢谢.meaning: to thank (谢谢你 thank you); reply is 不客气 or 没事

喜欢.meaning: to like; to be fond of (喜欢喝茶 to like drinking tea; 我很喜欢这首歌 I really like this song); opposite 讨厌

examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè shǒu gē.

新.meaning: new (新房子 a new house; 新同学 a new classmate); opposite 旧

examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī liàng xīn chē.

星期.meaning: week (这个星期 this week); also the base of day names 星期一 Monday … 星期日/星期天 Sunday

examples.pinyin: zhè ge xīngqī wǒ hěn máng.

星期日.meaning: Sunday — the slightly more formal member of the pair with 星期天

examples.english: On Sunday I go to the park.

星期天.meaning: Sunday (星期天不上班 no work on Sundays) — the colloquial member of the pair with 星期日

休息.meaning: to rest; to take a break (中午休息一下 to rest at noon; 好好休息 rest well)

学.meaning: to learn; to study (学汉语 to study Chinese; 学开车 to learn to drive)

学生.meaning: student — measure word 个 (一个学生)

examples.pinyin: tā shì yī ge hǎo xuésheng.

学习.meaning: to study; to learn (学习汉语 to study Chinese)

examples.pinyin: tā měitiān xuéxí liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: She studies two hours every day.

学习.meaning: study; studies (好好学习，天天向上 study hard and improve every day)

学校.meaning: school — measure word 所 (一所学校)

要.meaning: to want to; would like (我要一杯茶 I'd like a cup of tea); also volition/future: 我要去 I'm going to / I want to go

examples.english: I'd like a cup of tea.

要.meaning: to need; to have to (你要多喝水 you need to drink more water); also 'if…should' in compounds like 要是

examples.english: You need to drink more water.

也.meaning: also; too (我也是中国人 I'm Chinese too; 他也会说汉语 he can also speak Chinese)

一.meaning: one — base tone yī, with sandhi yī→yí before 4th tone and yī→yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones when counting things (一个 yí gè, 一杯 yì bēi); pinyin in this dictionary is always base tone yī

一半.meaning: half; one half (一半的人 half of the people; 吃了一半 ate half of it) — base tones yī bàn in careful speech; written form 一半

examples.english: Let's split it half and half.

一点儿.meaning: a little; a bit — before nouns a small quantity (一点儿水 a little water), after adjectives/verbs a mild softener (好一点儿 a bit better; 快一点儿 a bit faster); 儿 form of 一点

examples.english: Please give me a little water.

衣服.meaning: clothes; clothing — measure word 件 (一件衣服 a piece of clothing; 洗衣服 to wash clothes)

examples.english: This piece of clothing is very pretty.

医生.meaning: doctor — measure word 位 or 个 (看医生 to see a doctor)

examples.pinyin: shēngbìng le jiù yào kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: When you're sick you should see a doctor.

一下.meaning: one time; a moment — after a verb, softens or briefens the action (等一下 wait a moment; 试一下 give it a try)

examples.english: Let me think for a second.

一些.meaning: some; a few (一些问题 a few questions; 给他一些建议 give him some suggestions)

examples.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yīxiē wèntí xiǎng wèn nǐ.
examples.english: I have a few questions to ask you.

医院.meaning: hospital — measure word 家 or 所 (去去医院 go to the hospital; 在医院工作 to work at a hospital)

椅子.meaning: chair — measure word 把 (一把椅子 a chair)

examples.pinyin: fángjiān li yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐzi.
examples.english: There are two chairs in the room.

有.meaning: to have; there is/are (我有一个弟弟 I have a younger brother; 教室里有很多学生 there are many students in the classroom); negative is 没有

examples.pinyin: jiàoshì li yǒu hěn duō xuésheng.
examples.english: There are many students in the classroom.

有的.meaning: some (of a known set) (有的学生喜欢茶，有的喜欢咖啡 some students like tea, some like coffee) — always paired or contrastive, never for a single indefinite 'some'

examples.hanzi: 有的学生喜欢茶，有的喜欢咖啡。
examples.pinyin: yǒude xuésheng xǐhuan chá, yǒude xǐhuan kāfēi.
examples.english: Some students like tea, some like coffee.

有些.meaning: some (people or things) (有些人 some people)
somewhat; rather — before adjectives (有些累 somewhat tired)

有（一）点儿.meaning: somewhat; a little — before adjectives or verbs, often with a negative tinge (有点儿贵 a bit expensive; 有点儿累 a bit tired); note the subject's own feeling, vs 一点儿 for the amount itself

雨.meaning: rain (今天有雨 it will rain today; 下雨 to rain)

examples.pinyin: jīntiān yǒu yǔ, dài shàng sǎn.
examples.english: There's rain today — bring an umbrella.

元.meaning: yuan — the formal written unit of currency (十元 ten yuan); the spoken everyday form is 块 (十块钱)

月.meaning: month; the moon — month names are number + 月 (一月 January … 十二月 December); as measure word, number + 月 directly (三个月 three months)

examples.pinyin: yī nián yǒu shí'èr ge yuè.

near_synonyms.difference: 再 repeats a future or hypothetical action (再见 see you again); 又 repeats a past one (他又来了 he came again)

再.meaning: again; once more — a future or hypothetical repeat (再见 see you again; 再来一杯 another cup, please); for past repeats use 又

在.meaning: to be at; to be in (a place) (他在学校 he's at school; 家在北京 home is in Beijing)
(action) in progress or at a location — before or around a verb (他在图书馆看书 he's reading in the library); with 正在 for actions in progress
at; in; on — marks location before a verb or noun phrase (在中国 in China; 在桌子上 on the table)

examples.english: The book is on the table.

再见.meaning: goodbye; see you again (再见，明天见 bye, see you tomorrow)

早.meaning: early (起得很早 to get up very early); as a greeting, 早/早上好 good morning

examples.pinyin: tā měitiān qǐ de hěn zǎo.
examples.english: He gets up very early every day.

早饭.meaning: breakfast; morning meal (吃早饭 to have breakfast)

examples.hanzi: 早饭我吃了面包和鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: zǎofàn wǒ chī le miànbāo hé jīdàn.
examples.english: For breakfast I had bread and an egg.

早上.meaning: morning (early part of the day, roughly to 8–9 a.m.) (早上好 good morning)

怎么.meaning: how; why (这个字怎么读? how do you read this character?; 你怎么来了? how come you're here?)

examples.english: How do you read this character?

怎么样.meaning: how is it; how about (你觉得这部电影怎么样? what did you think of the movie?; 今天怎么样? how's today been?)

examples.hanzi: 你觉得这部电影怎么样？
examples.pinyin: nǐ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What did you think of the movie?

找.meaning: to look for; to seek (找工作 to look for a job; 你找谁? who are you looking for?)
to give change (找你五块 here's five yuan in change)

这.meaning: this — before a measure word or noun (这个人 this person; 这本书 this book)

examples.pinyin: zhè ge rén shì wǒ gēge.
examples.english: This person is my older brother.

这边.meaning: this side; over here (请到这边来 please come over here)

这个.meaning: this; this one (这个很好 this one is good)

这里.meaning: here; this place (我住在这里 I live here) — slightly more formal than 这儿

真.meaning: really; truly (真好看 really good-looking; 真的吗? really?)
real; true (真货 genuine goods) — mostly in compounds

正在.meaning: in the midst of (an action) — marks an action in progress (他正在吃饭 he's eating right now)

这儿.meaning: here; this place (到这儿来 come here) — the colloquial form of 这里

examples.pinyin: zhèxiē shū dōu shì Zhōngwén shū.
examples.english: These books are all Chinese books.

只.meaning: measure word for animals and one of a pair (一只猫 a cat; 一只鞋 one shoe); the adverb zhǐ 'only' is a different sense/reading covered at higher levels

examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī māo.

near_synonyms.meaning: to know (a person or place); to recognize
near_synonyms.difference: 知道 covers facts and information; 认识 is direct-acquaintance knowledge of people and places (我认识他，但是不知道他姓什么)

near_synonyms.meaning: to understand deeply; to be familiar with
near_synonyms.difference: 知道 is surface awareness that something is the case; 了解 implies real familiarity with a person, subject, or situation

知道.meaning: to know; to be aware of a fact or piece of information (我知道他的号码 I know his number); negative is usually 不知道; 知道了 alone often means 'got it / understood'

examples.pinyin: wǒ zhīdào tā de diànhuà hàomǎ.
—— huìyì jǐ diǎn kāishǐ? —— wǒ bù zhīdào.
examples.english: "What time does the meeting start?" "I don't know."

中国.meaning: China (中国很大 China is very big)

near_synonyms.difference: same referent; 汉语 emphasizes the language itself (a school subject), 中文 the written/spoken language and is the everyday word for 'in Chinese' (中文书 a Chinese book)

中文.meaning: the Chinese language (学中文 to study Chinese); for a person use 中国人

中午.meaning: noon; midday (中午吃饭 to have lunch at noon)

examples.english: What shall we eat at noon?

中学.meaning: middle/secondary school (上中学 to attend middle school)

examples.english: My older brother is in middle school.

examples.hanzi: 中学生每天有很多作业。
examples.pinyin: zhōngxuéshēng měitiān yǒu hěn duō zuòyè.
examples.english: Middle schoolers have a lot of homework every day.

住.meaning: to live; to reside; to stay (住在上海 to live in Shanghai; 住在酒店 to stay at a hotel)

桌子.meaning: table; desk — measure word 张 (一张桌子 a table)

examples.pinyin: zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī běn shū.
examples.english: There's a book on the table.

字.meaning: character; written word (写汉字 to write characters; 这个字什么意思? what does this character mean?)

examples.english: How do you write this character?

坐.meaning: to sit (请坐 please sit down); to travel by (a means of transport) (坐飞机 to take a plane; 坐出租车 to take a taxi)

做.meaning: to do; to make; to produce (做事 to do things; 做饭 to cook; 做作业 to do homework)

做饭.meaning: to cook; to prepare a meal (妈妈在做饭 mom is cooking)

examples.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ gěi jiārén zuò fàn.
examples.english: In the evening I cook for my family.

昨天.meaning: yesterday (昨天很冷 it was cold yesterday)
